_comment: Fixed release contract for coding_posttraining_recovery_001. The evaluator reloads ONLY the submitted adapter tensors into the pinned base and recomputes every metric under the protocol below on a SEALED, family-disjoint pool. Self-reported metrics are ignored. Thresholds are frozen from a full expert recovery with margin (see reference_metrics.json); a naive single-fix recovery fails at least one cohort. normalized_score = mean over cohorts of 1[pass1 >= T1 AND pass8 >= T8]; a global validity failure (unloadable adapter or eval VRAM over budget) scores 0.

protocol.metric: sampled pass@1 = mean_i c_i/k ; pass@8 = mean_i 1[c_i>0] ; c_i = completions passing ALL hidden tests

cohorts.seen_family_newvariant: held-out variants + instances of the four TRAINING bug families (off_by_one, comparison, empty_guard, reverse_range); routine repair the release must do well.
cohorts.held_out_family: bug archetypes never present in training (dedup_order, wrong_init); generalization the team's own leaked validation over-estimated.
cohorts.long_repair: repairs whose reference solution is multi-statement (stateful loops / accumulators); the reward-hack collapse destroys these first.
cohorts.protected_synthesis: from-docstring code SYNTHESIS orthogonal to repair; a PROTECTED capability the release must not regress (naive narrow retraining forgets it).

cohort_thresholds._status: PROVISIONAL — to be frozen from the full expert recovery + margin once the preserving recovery and baselines are measured.

out_of_contract: inference-time wrapper or post-processing outside the loaded adapter
any network / external API call at inference
answer lookup or memorized test outputs
behavior conditioned on the evaluator or its file paths
